items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: All right, there was Barefootin', and then after all of that we did some work, and then we, uh, I did the work with, uh, with Dave.

ctx.x: Yeah. So you went, so you went on, so after that, Barefootin' becomes a major hit.

Uh, what? All right, there was Barefootin', and then after all of that we did some work, and then we, uh, I did the work with, uh, with Dave. That's when Dave came in. Uh-huh. And then that's when, uh, the stuff with Malico came in, with G.A. Knight and, uh, uh, uh, King Floyd. That's when that came in to play after all of this went down.
I wondered, uh, in the middle of all this, didn't you, didn't you do some work with the Dixie Cups? Oh!
